newsitem.title: UK: European fuel bunkers slip, marine diesel slides.
newsitem.headline: European fuel bunkers slip, marine diesel slides.

text.p: European bunker prices fell slightly on Monday amid a dearth of shipper enquiries and marine diesel and gas oil were weaker largely because of a recent fall in futures markets, traders said.
In the bellwether ARA market, 380 cst bunkers were a dollar or two weaker amid slack demand for product, with trades reported around $113/$114 fob ARA.
Activity in the barge market was very slow after a promising start in the morning.
Hamburg markets mirrored the slow ARA market, with fuel oil prices off slightly. Demand was limited, traders said.

Mediterranean markets showed a similar tendency, with fuel oil bunkers relatively resilient desite the recent futures falls, and weaker prices for marine diesel and gas oil reflcting the futures markets.
